# scripts

Run from the project root with `python3 scripts/<name>`.

## Data

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [backfill_announcements.py](backfill_announcements.py) | One-time backfill of NSE corporate announcements across the full Nifty 50 universe. |
| [backfill_bars.py](backfill_bars.py) | Ingest OHLCV for the full survivorship-bias-free pool + the Nifty 50 index. |
| [backfill_board_meetings.py](backfill_board_meetings.py) | NSE board-meeting intimations (2010 onwards) for the instrument pool, with the exchange's publication timestamp. |
| [backfill_delivery.py](backfill_delivery.py) | One-time backfill of NSE delivery data: one request per weekday covers the whole exchange. |
| [backfill_fii_dii.py](backfill_fii_dii.py) | Backfill FII (2021-01 -> today, ~70 monthly requests) and DII (2026-06 -> today) net equity flow. |
| [backfill_fundamentals.py](backfill_fundamentals.py) | One-time backfill of NSE XBRL fundamentals across the full Nifty 50 universe. |
| [backfill_global.py](backfill_global.py) | Daily S&P 500, US VIX and Nifty 50 index bars from Yahoo into data/raw/global/, each stamped with the moment it became known. |
| [backfill_history.py](backfill_history.py) | Pre-2021 daily bars and India VIX (Yahoo), kept in data/raw/history/ so the live caches and ledgers are untouched. |
| [backfill_insurance_fundamentals.py](backfill_insurance_fundamentals.py) | Extract SBILIFE/HDFCLIFE fundamentals from their filing PDFs (found via the cached announcements). |
| [backfill_intraday.py](backfill_intraday.py) | Daily intraday-volatility summaries from the public 1-minute NSE dataset on Hugging Face (MIT, sourced from Upstox). |
| [backfill_options.py](backfill_options.py) | Stream NSE daily F&O bhavcopy zips (2021 onwards), keep only a per-symbol option summary. |

## Build and serve

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [build_alt_indexes.py](build_alt_indexes.py) | Embed the corpus with alternative Ollama embedding models into separate indexes (resumable). |
| [build_chronos_history.py](build_chronos_history.py) | Chronos zero-shot volatility features for the pre-2021 rows. |
| [build_docs.py](build_docs.py) | Generate the folder READMEs, the report index and the API reference from the code itself, so they cannot drift. |
| [build_final_stats_pdf.py](build_final_stats_pdf.py) | Builds reports/FINAL_STATS.pdf (all headline results, with the honest verdict). |
| [build_serving_artifacts.py](build_serving_artifacts.py) | Build everything the /v3 service needs: (1) the point-in-time serving feature store (UNLABELLED, so the newest day is present; membership-filtered; same-day ranks computed within the real index members), (2) the final ensemble trained on all labelled point-in-time rows, registered with a checksum. |
| [build_tracker_xlsx.py](build_tracker_xlsx.py) | Regenerate TRACKER.xlsx from TRACKER.md (source of truth): checklist items + known simplifications, styling kept from the existing workbook. |
| [build_vector_index.py](build_vector_index.py) | Embed the whole announcement corpus once (resumable, deduplicated), then benchmark indexed retrieval latency. |
| [calibrate_drift.py](calibrate_drift.py) | Calibrate drift-alert thresholds to this model's own history and save them next to the model. |
| [calibrate_impact.py](calibrate_impact.py) | Fit ImpactCostModel from real fills: python3 scripts/calibrate_impact.py fills.csv [--fee-bps 10] [--capital 1e8] Writes reports/impact_calibration.json. `--dry-run` uses SYNTHETIC fills (pipeline check only; results are meaningless). |
| [daily_refresh.py](daily_refresh.py) | One command to keep the forward test accruing (safe to run daily; a no-op between rebalances): Yahoo bars refresh -> if a rebalance is due (>= hold_days trading days since the last book) rebuild serving features -> paper_trade. |
| [forecast_volatility.py](forecast_volatility.py) | Forecast 5- and 20-day volatility for current index members, record them in the forward ledger, score matured ones. |
| [human_agreement.py](human_agreement.py) | After labelling: agreement of the human grades with the local LLM judges (and with the third LLM rater's grades where both exist), plus how much the retrieval ranking conclusions change when human grades override model grades on the labelled pairs. |
| [label_cli.py](label_cli.py) | Blind human relevance labelling (model grades are NOT shown). |
| [overnight_signal.py](overnight_signal.py) | Today's pre-open Nifty direction signal from the latest S&P 500 close (needs network). |
| [paper_trade.py](paper_trade.py) | Record today's pre-registered paper book if a rebalance is due (never edits history), then score the ledger so far. |
| [serve.py](serve.py) | Run the /v3 service (localhost only by default). |
| [train_event_classifier.py](train_event_classifier.py) | Train + evaluate + save the production event classifier. 1) fit on <= 2024-12 -> choose the abstain threshold on 2025-01..05 (smallest threshold with >= 99% accepted accuracy); 2) refit on <= 2025-05 with that threshold -> score the untouched test period (>= 2025-06): accuracy without abstention, and accuracy/coverage at the threshold; 3) save data/processed/models/event_classifier.joblib (metrics inside). |

## Studies

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [run_blend_seeds.py](run_blend_seeds.py) | Seed robustness of the faint cross-sectional signal + tree blend (no data given up to calibration slices). |
| [run_cost_sensitivity.py](run_cost_sensitivity.py) | How wrong can the (uncalibrated) impact coefficient be before the conclusion flips? LightGBM walk-forward long/short, net Sharpe grid. |
| [run_cpcv_full.py](run_cpcv_full.py) | CPCV with date-neutral metrics for LightGBM and the full calibrated ensemble -> reports/cpcv_full.json. |
| [run_digest_eval.py](run_digest_eval.py) | Digest-fallback gate: rebuild the real evidence packs (routing + qwen3:8b rerank) for the explain-study questions, read the cached model answers and the judge answerability, sweep the reranker-score gate; tune on even ids, confirm on odd. |
| [run_event_classifier.py](run_event_classifier.py) | Announcement EVENT-TYPE classification with the category label masked out of the text (so it cannot be solved by lookup), temporal holdout (train <= 2025-05-31, test after), three models: TF-IDF+LR, mxbai-embedding+LR, and a zero-shot Ollama LLM on a test subsample. |
| [run_event_classifier_v2.py](run_event_classifier_v2.py) | v2 (train<=2024-12, val 2025-01..05 for ALL tuning, test>=2025-06 touched once). |
| [run_explain_eval.py](run_explain_eval.py) | Faithfulness study of /v3/explain: 50 questions (30 with a 365-day window, 20 with a 14-day window where relevant evidence often does not exist), real llama3.2:3b answers through retrieve -> generate -> guardrails (the answer text is captured even when the guardrails withhold it). |
| [run_filing_qa.py](run_filing_qa.py) | Filing QA accuracy with machine-verifiable gold answers: (1) dividend RECORD DATE, (2) financial-results PERIOD-END date. |
| [run_fusion_study.py](run_fusion_study.py) | Weighted-RRF study with a proper tune/holdout split (no selection on the evaluation queries): 200 instrument+category queries, weights chosen on the first 100, reported on the held-out 100. |
| [run_guardrail_probe.py](run_guardrail_probe.py) | Offline probe of the guardrails (no LLM): real evidence packs (4 filings of one company) + planted answers. |
| [run_guardrail_threshold.py](run_guardrail_threshold.py) | Replays the CACHED real model answers of the explain study through the guardrails at several overlap thresholds (packs rebuilt with routing+rerank, no new generation). |
| [run_intraday_direction.py](run_intraday_direction.py) | Tradable intraday direction test on Yahoo HOURLY bars (~2 years). |
| [run_judged_eval.py](run_judged_eval.py) | Content-judged retrieval evaluation: 60 natural-language queries (30 company-specific, 30 market-wide), pooled candidates from every system, graded 0-3 relevance from two independent local LLM judges (agreement reported), systems compared on graded nDCG@5 with paired bootstrap-free SEs. |
| [run_label_study.py](run_label_study.py) | Label-design study (Blueprint §3.3): does vol-scaled triple-barrier labelling and/or uniqueness weighting beat the plain 5-day direction label -- judged on the SAME target (5d direction) with paired purged walk-forward folds x seeds -- and does a meta-label filter raise primary-trade hit rate? Pre-set: k=1.0, h=5 (no tuning). |
| [run_llm_direction.py](run_llm_direction.py) | Can a local LLM call next-day direction from a company announcement? Strictly point-in-time: the model sees only the announcement text, company and date; entry = first close at/after publication (after 15:30 -> next day's close), exit = the following close (1 trading day). |
| [run_longshort.py](run_longshort.py) | Market-neutral cross-sectional long/short on walk-forward OOS scores, net of impact costs, vs a within-date permutation null. |
| [run_longshort_models.py](run_longshort_models.py) | Market-neutral long/short on walk-forward OOS scores for EVERY model family (LightGBM, elastic-net logistic, CatBoost, stacked calibrated ensemble, rank-average) - closes the 'LightGBM-only portfolio test' caveat. |
| [run_nested_hpo.py](run_nested_hpo.py) | Nested random search for LightGBM on the real PIT dataset -> reports/nested_hpo.json. |
| [run_nli_probe.py](run_nli_probe.py) | Probe: lexical guardrail vs pretrained-NLI guardrail vs both, on 150 real evidence packs x 8 planted answers (3 faithful, 5 fabricated). |
| [run_nli_replay.py](run_nli_replay.py) | Replay the cached REAL model answers (all judged faithful) through lexical + NLI-veto guardrails; shows what the NLI veto would withhold. |
| [run_overnight_direction.py](run_overnight_direction.py) | Does the US close predict Indian direction? Strictly point-in-time: the US session of calendar date d closes (~02:00 IST) BEFORE the next Indian open, so r_us(d) is known when Indian trading day T (first Indian trading date > d) opens. |
| [run_phase2_fundamentals_fii_dii_ablation.py](run_phase2_fundamentals_fii_dii_ablation.py) | Paired, identical-fold ablation (Blueprint §4.10/§28): does adding fundamentals + FII/DII flow improve out-of-sample prediction? One dataset, one set of purged/embargoed folds, a single LightGBM fit with vs. without those columns -- the only difference is the feature set. |
| [run_phase2_pipeline.py](run_phase2_pipeline.py) | End-to-end Phase 2 pipeline (Blueprint §6.2): every enrichment layer -> purged/embargoed walk-forward -> champion/challenger ensemble (logistic + LightGBM + CatBoost -> meta -> calibrated) -> selective prediction, regime-segmented metrics, cost-stressed backtest -> locked report. |
| [run_phase3_ablation.py](run_phase3_ablation.py) | RAG feature ablation: does the event layer add incremental value? (Blueprint §4.10, §28) |
| [run_phase3_fullscale_eval.py](run_phase3_fullscale_eval.py) | Full-corpus (58k docs) retrieval evaluation via the persistent index: RRF vs RRF+LLM rerank; relevant = same instrument AND category. |
| [run_phase3_pipeline.py](run_phase3_pipeline.py) | End-to-end Phase 3 pipeline (Blueprint Part 4, §6.2 weeks 12-16). |
| [run_phase3_rerank_eval.py](run_phase3_rerank_eval.py) | Does LLM reranking help? Stricter benchmark than the same-instrument proxy: a document is relevant only if it has the query's instrument AND category (structured labels the retriever never sees; it sees text only). |
| [run_portfolio_backtest.py](run_portfolio_backtest.py) | Do the Portfolio page's swing figures hold? Random long-only mixes on past out-of-sample forecast dates (non-overlapping): the page says moves stay within +/-1 "typical" about 68% of the time and within the "rough 1-in-10" figure 90% of the time. |
| [run_preopen_direction.py](run_preopen_direction.py) | Pre-open direction model: everything here is known at 09:00 IST of Indian trading day T (as-of strictly BEFORE T's calendar date): US indices (S&P, Nasdaq), US VIX change, dollar index, Brent, gold, US 10y yield change, USD/INR, plus Indian previous-day return/gap. |
| [run_preopen_stocks.py](run_preopen_stocks.py) | Stock-level pre-open model v2: adds per-stock trailing betas (60 prior days, current day excluded) of the stock's own gap to S&P, Nasdaq, dollar index, Brent and USD/INR, beta x same-night driver interaction terms, sector code, weekday, and the stock's trailing 20-day mean gap. |
| [run_pretrained_direction.py](run_pretrained_direction.py) | Pretrained models on the direction problem, honest zero-shot tests: (A) ProsusAI/finbert sentiment of 400 real announcements -> next-day direction (same sample/entry/exit as run_llm_direction.py); (B) amazon/chronos-bolt-small time-series foundation model, zero-shot on the last 256 closes of 3,000 random (stock, day) points -> next-1-day and 5-day direction. |

## Other
